stem: The sum of two roots of a quadratic equation is 7 and sum of their cubes is 91, find the equation.
solution: Let the roots be \(\alpha\) and \(\beta\). Given \(\alpha + \beta = 7\) and \(\alpha^3 + \beta^3 = 91\). Using \(\alpha^3 + \beta^3 = (\alpha + \beta)^3 - 3\alpha\beta(\alpha + \beta)\): \(91 = 7^3 - 3\alpha\beta(7) = 343 - 21\alpha\beta\). So \(21\alpha\beta = 343 - 91 = 252\), giving \(\alpha\beta = 12\). The required equation is \(x^2 - (\alpha + \beta)x + \alpha\beta = 0\), i.e. \(x^2 - 7x + 12 = 0\).

subtopic: Shares — Face Value, Market Value, Brokerage
stem: Smt. Tejaswini purchased 100 shares of FV \(\text{₹}\,80\) when the MV is \(\text{₹}\,900\). She paid brokerage at the rate of \(0.5\%\) and \(18\%\) GST on brokerage. Find the following: (1) Net amount paid for 100 shares. (2) Brokerage paid on sum invested. (3) GST paid on brokerage. (4) Total amount paid for 100 shares.
solution: (1) Net amount (sum invested) for 100 shares \(= 100\times \text{MV} = 100\times 900 = \text{₹}\,90{,}000\). (2) Brokerage \(= 0.5\%\) of \(90{,}000 = \dfrac{0.5}{100}\times 90{,}000 = \text{₹}\,450\). (3) GST on brokerage \(= 18\%\) of \(450 = \dfrac{18}{100}\times 450 = \text{₹}\,81\). (4) Total amount paid \(= 90{,}000 + 450 + 81 = \text{₹}\,90{,}531\).

subtopic: Mean, Median and Mode of Grouped Data
stem:
The following table shows the funds collected by 105 students for flood affected people. Find the median of the data.

| Fund (Rupees) | No. of Students |
|---|---|
| 10–20 | 10 |
| 20–30 | 37 |
| 30–40 | 15 |
| 40–50 | 20 |
| 50–60 | 7 |
| 60–70 | 8 |
| 70–80 | 8 |
solution: \(N = 105\), so \(\dfrac{N}{2} = 52.5\). Cumulative frequencies: \(10, 47, 62, 82, 89, 97, 105\). The cumulative frequency just exceeding \(52.5\) is \(62\), so the median class is \(30\text{–}40\). Here \(L = 30,\ cf = 47,\ f = 15,\ h = 10\). Median \(= L + \dfrac{\frac{N}{2} - cf}{f}\times h = 30 + \dfrac{52.5 - 47}{15}\times 10 = 30 + \dfrac{5.5\times 10}{15} = 30 + \dfrac{55}{15} = 30 + 3.67 \approx 33.67\). Median \(\approx \text{₹}\,33.67\).
